cards.art: fat spider in top hat weaving neon web over globe
cards.lore: You will own nothing. The 2030 Agenda isn't a prediction; it's a schedule.
cards.name: THE WEAVER
cards.power: The Great Reset. Forces all players to discard their 'Property' cards.

cards.art: bat in business suit injecting glowing FUNDING syringe into school
cards.lore: Funding the control grid, one grant at a time. The revolution will be funded.
cards.name: THE PHILANTHRO-VAMPIRE
cards.power: Common Core Injection. Pay 2 Billion to standardize all opponent hands.

cards.art: oil-soaked skeleton eagle clutching education charter scroll
cards.lore: Founded in 1903 to replace education with obedience. We don't want thinkers; we want workers.
cards.name: THE OIL BARON GHOST
cards.power: Standardize the Soul. Nullifies any 'Critical Thinking' cards in play.

cards.art: industrious beaver stacking ABC blocks spelling COMPLIANCE beside engineering plans
cards.lore: The castle on the hill. Born from a meeting at Fetzer in 1994 to manufacture the 'Whole Child'.
cards.name: THE SOCIAL ENGINEER
cards.power: The Doorway. Opens the path for all other 'Programming' cards to enter the game.

cards.art: mechanical chameleon camouflaged as teacher, drones tagged Privacy buzzing in classroom
cards.lore: Connecting the world to the database. $3.3 million invested to map your child's heart.
cards.name: THE DATA MERCHANT
cards.power: Meta-Extraction. Steal 1 "Secret" from every player.

cards.art: great white shark in business suit brandishing calculator showing 11:1
cards.lore: Columbia University confirmed: SEL programs generate an $11 return for every $1 invested.
cards.name: THE ROI SHARK
cards.power: Human Capital Futures. Gain $11 for every $1 spent on "Programming" cards.

cards.art: hyena in suit presenting glowing Digital ID blueprint
cards.lore: Building the infrastructure for the Fourth Industrial Revolution. Pro bono support for total control.
cards.name: THE CONSULTANT
cards.power: The Blueprint. View top 3 cards of the deck and rearrange them.

cards.art: glowing owl reading Spirituality book radiating brain-wave energy
cards.lore: Decoding the "Neurophilosophy of Free Will" so we can delete it. Funding the spiritual shift since the 90s.
cards.name: THE UNSEEN HAND
cards.power: Neurophilosophy. Force an opponent to reroll their "Free Will" check.

cards.art: cute colorful worm infiltrating red apple labeled Health
cards.lore: Social Emotional Learning: The psychological doorway. "We don't want their math scores; we want their souls."
cards.name: S.E.L. (THE WORM)
cards.power: Trojan Horse. This card cannot be blocked. It enters play disguised as a "Health" card.

cards.art: patched teddy bear wired to electrodes, blue-gloved hands controlling
cards.lore: A comprehensive seizure of the child's development. School, home, and community—all monitored.
cards.name: THE WHOLE CHILD
cards.power: Cradle to Grave. Attach this card to a "Student" card to control them for the rest of the game.

cards.art: exhausted donkey crushed beneath heavy safe labeled TRAUMA, grinning through pain
cards.lore: Training you to tolerate the dystopia. "Resilience" is just obedience under pressure.
cards.name: RESILIENCE
cards.power: Grit Training. The target must endure damage without complaining.

cards.art: robotic figure using industrial axe to shorten giraffe to elephant height, bureaucratic scale behind
cards.lore: Standardization disguised as fairness. "Transformative SEL" examines root causes to disrupt norms.
cards.name: EQUITY
cards.power: Outcome Equalizer. All players must discard down to the lowest hand size.

cards.art: assembly line converting squealing piglets into identical grey concrete blocks
cards.lore: Training for the PreK-Adult workforce. Schooling is increasingly irrelevant to anything but obeying orders.
cards.name: OBEDIENCE SCHOOL
cards.power: Batch Process. Convert 3 "Individual" tokens into "Worker" tokens.

cards.art: armored mole with GoPro helmet excavating diaries labeled My Secrets
cards.lore: How do you feel today? The algorithm needs to know. Aggregating "feelings" for the state database.
cards.name: THE DATA MINER
cards.power: Psychographic Profiling. Look at an opponent's hand and name their insecurities.

cards.art: wolf in nurse uniform with butterfly net and mental health checklist, hunting
cards.lore: Separating the child from the family unit. Diagnosing normal childhood as a disorder.
cards.name: THE COUNSELOR
cards.power: Early Intervention. Remove a 'Parent' card from play to 'support' the child.

cards.art: UN-branded pigeon beside clock face filled with ZERO HOUR labels, gears turning
cards.lore: 17 Goals to transform the world. Goal #4: Your Mind. "Ensuring inclusive and equitable quality education..."
cards.name: THE 2030 AGENDA
cards.power: Timeline Acceleration. Skip the opponent's next turn.

cards.art: snake with screen face coiling tightly around human wrist, eye watching
cards.lore: Vibrates when you feel the "wrong" emotion. Tracks stress to "switch to a positive response".
cards.name: THE SMART WATCH
cards.power: Haptic Feedback. Force a player to change their last action.

cards.art: ostrich wearing boxy VR headset, head down, while wildfire engulfs background
cards.lore: Escape the pod life! Enter the Metaverse! 97% of adolescents already play video games—the trap is set.
cards.name: THE VR HEADSET
cards.power: Metaverse Exile. Place a player in "Time Out" for 2 turns.

cards.art: giant camera lens with human eye aperture trained on panicked rabbit
cards.name: THE BIOMETRIC SCANNER

cards.art: close-up cow face with yellow ear tag reading 666-ID with QR code
cards.lore: Your passport to society. "Global citizenship" requires a digital leash. Revocable at any time.
cards.name: THE DIGITAL ID
cards.power: Access Denied. Block a player from using "Cash" or "Travel" cards.

cards.art: armored dragon stamping REJECTED documents, glowing scoreboard showing citizen rankings
cards.lore: Good Citizen! +10 Points. Bad Thought! -50 Points. The model is already global.
cards.name: THE SCOREKEEPER
cards.power: Social Credit. If your score drops below 0, you lose the game immediately.

cards.art: black sheep illuminated by laser projecting glowing red X
cards.lore: Non-compliance detected. You are now a health risk. Access to the playground denied.
cards.name: THE 'BAD' BADGE
cards.power: Cancel Culture. Target player cannot speak for one round.

cards.art: bees with UN sashes and barcode stickers swarming neon hive
cards.lore: Citizenship is no longer national. It is digital. It is owned. "One mindset, one belief system."
cards.name: THE GLOBAL CITIZEN
cards.power: Hive Mind. All players must vote the same way or take damage.

cards.art: frantic hamster in wooden wheel connected via cables to glowing server rack
cards.lore: Obedience training doesn't stop at 18. Re-training. Re-programming. Until death.
cards.name: THE LIFELONG LEARNER
cards.power: Re-skilling. Discard your hand and draw new cards you didn't want.

cards.art: squid-faced bureaucrat in suit, red tentacles reaching into multiple schoolhouses
cards.lore: Unconstitutional since 1979. A centralized control hub for the indoctrination machine.
cards.name: THE DEPT OF ED
cards.power: Federal Overreach. Take half of every player's "Tax" tokens.

cards.art: oversized golden gavel smashing piggy bank over funnel marked Fines
cards.lore: Legislation by coercion. Federal funds come with strings attached. "Dance, puppet, dance."
cards.name: THE MANDATE
cards.power: Coercion. Players must pay a fine or lose a turn.

cards.art: stork in aviator gear dropping crates labeled SEL SYSTEM over tropical jungle
cards.lore: Exporting the obedience model to 110 countries. "Policy recommendations for areas of crisis."
cards.name: USAID
cards.power: Foreign Aid. Spread the infection to a new territory.

cards.art: massive spider in web catching data-tagged butterflies, government files visible in web strands
cards.lore: Statewide Longitudinal Data System. Tracking you from Pre-K to the grave. We know where you live.
cards.name: THE CENSUS
cards.power: SLDS Tracking. Retrieve any card from the discard pile if you have the data.

cards.art: chimpanzee with glowing neural implant fused to computer terminal, data streaming
cards.lore: The final goal: Merging biology with the machine. "A new demography of human-robots."
cards.name: THE MERGED MIND
cards.power: Hive Integration. Share your hand with all other players. Privacy is obsolete.

cards.art: chrome robot dog with TV screen face showing ILLEGAL EMOTION cornering small child
cards.lore: Predicting crime based on your feelings. "Decoding intentions to guide behavior."
cards.name: THE EMOTION POLICE
cards.power: Pre-Crime. Negate an action before it happens.

cards.art: translucent cicada exoskeleton clinging to bark, hollow eye sockets, muted palette
cards.lore: A perfectly obedient shell. The spirit has left the building. "Psychological culling."
cards.name: THE EMPTY SHELL
cards.power: Hollowed Out. This card has no effect but takes up space in your hand.

cards.art: single goldfish in clean round bowl, pastoral clouds visible through glass, perfectly contained
cards.lore: Safe. Secure. Monitored. Controlled. "You will be happy."
cards.name: THE NEW NORMAL
cards.power: Lockdown. No players can draw cards next turn.

cards.art: fierce mother hen fighting off surveillance drone, chicks sheltering behind her
cards.lore: The only way to win is not to play their game. Build the network.
cards.name: THE HOMESCHOOLER
cards.power: Opt Out. Immune to all 'School' and 'Indoctrination' effects.

cards.art: bull standing triumphant atop coins and bills, crushing robotic card-payment arm
cards.lore: Freedom is physical. Use it or lose it. Starve the digital beast.
cards.name: CASH IS KING
cards.power: Untraceable. Transactions made with this card cannot be blocked or tracked.

cards.art: badger in work gloves tending vegetable garden, industrial city burning on horizon
cards.lore: Build parallel systems. Starve the beast. Grow your own food. Know your neighbor.
cards.name: LOCAL ROOTS
cards.power: Parallel System. Generate resources without the Bank.

cards.art: defiant orange cat in leather jacket smashing surveillance camera off wall
cards.lore: I do not consent. I do not comply. "If they win minds, they win. Without obedience, they fail."
cards.name: THE NON-COMPLIER
cards.power: Ungovernable. Cancel any "Mandate" card played against you.

cards.art: peacock spreading tail feathers covered in glowing eyes and data points
cards.lore: Founded by Garland's son-in-law. #1 supplier of SEL measurement tools. "We know what you think before you do."
cards.name: PANORAMA EDUCATION
cards.power: The Survey. Force opponents to reveal their hand.

cards.art: row of hamsters marching into glowing digital corridor labeled SECOND STEP, binary code walls
cards.lore: Running in 34% of U.S. elementary schools. Funded by Gates to transform 100 million children by 2030.
cards.name: SECOND STEP
cards.power: Curriculum Shift. Replace an opponent's "Skill" with "Empathy".

cards.art: rat in wizard hat conjuring tiny human figures over flask labeled Human Capital, ROI chart behind
cards.lore: Invest, Develop, Sustain, Gain. "Get them at birth for the highest ROI."
cards.name: THE HECKMAN EQUATION
cards.power: Early Investment. Gain control of a "Child" card at the start of the game (Birth to 5).

cards.art: massive python coiling around distressed Earth globe, ruler and measuring tape as scales
cards.lore: International Survey on Social and Emotional Skills. Identifying practices to "foster obedience" globally.
cards.name: OECD / PISA
cards.power: Global Standard. Align all players' stats to the international average.

cards.art: grey pigeon with UN messenger bag dropping curriculum documents over illustrated world map
cards.lore: Ensuring 'inclusive and equitable' obedience for all. 2030 Agenda in full flight.
cards.name: UNESCO
cards.power: Global Curriculum. Change the rules of the game to match UN Goal #4.

cards.art: chrome piggy bank built like tank with gun turret aimed at small schoolhouse
cards.lore: 'Learning and Resilience.' Mandating SEL in exchange for funding in 110 countries.
cards.name: THE WORLD BANK
cards.power: Debt Trap. Loan money to a player; they now must obey your commands.

cards.art: armored scarab beetle displaying glowing digital driver's license
cards.lore: 8th largest defense contractor. Handling your Digital ID and mobile driver's license. For your "safety".
cards.name: THALES
cards.power: Identity Management. Verify or deny a player's identity.

cards.art: uniformed kangaroo officer cuffing frightened joey with glowing digital chains
cards.lore: Australia's eSmart Digital License. Data mining children under the guise of internet safety.
cards.name: THE 'PEN' LICENSE
cards.power: eSmart. Player cannot communicate online without a permit.

cards.art: complacent frog sitting in gently bubbling stewpot, smiling, hand turning dial beneath
cards.lore: They slowly turn up the heat so you don't know you're being cooked. Incremental tyranny.
cards.name: GRADUALISM
cards.power: Slow Boil. Damage dealt increases by 1 each turn.

cards.art: two snakes of different colors locked in battle biting each other, surrounded by fire
cards.lore: Create the crisis, then save the day. The outcome is always the same: More Control.
cards.name: DIALECTIC
cards.power: Problem-Reaction-Solution. Create a crisis to play a solution card from your deck.

cards.art: green parrot speaking Equity, ornate mirror reflecting parrot saying Control
cards.lore: Changing definitions to confuse the enemy. "Empathy" now means "Obedience".
cards.name: SEMANTIC DECEPTION
cards.power: Redefinition. Change the text of one card in play.

cards.art: medical syringe wrapped in flowing red ribbon and bow, electricity crackling
cards.lore: You have free will, as long as you choose what we want you to choose.
cards.name: THE NUDGE
cards.power: Behavioral Econ. Force a player to make a "choice" they didn't want to make.

cards.art: goat in lotus pose atop piled money bags with occult symbols, halo of grant dollars
cards.lore: Rockefeller and Fetzer funded. "Spirituality" in education to nurture the "Global Soul".
cards.name: THE COLLABORATIVE
cards.power: Authorized Keeper. Decide which "Spiritual" cards are legal in play.

cards.art: brain suspended in green jar connected to FREE WILL DECODER console with dial controls
cards.lore: Decoding free will so we can delete it. 17 Universities researching how to predict your choices.
cards.name: NEUROPHILOSOPHY
cards.power: Decode Intent. Look at the next 3 cards in the deck.

cards.art: golden cobra emerging from smartphone screen, hypnotic gaze on dazed teenager
cards.lore: Apps that "train brains." Funded by Zuckerberg and NIH. Insight into the nature of the self... for data.
cards.name: MINDFULNESS APP
cards.power: Train Brain. Target player loses their turn to 'meditate'.

cards.art: beaver in mortarboard walking along path from sign AWOKEN toward signpost reading THE NIGHTMARE
cards.lore: Supporting emerging adults through wellness programs. Waking them up to the nightmare.
cards.name: THE AWAKENED CAMPUS
cards.power: Emerging Adult. Convert a 'Student' into an 'Activist'.

cards.art: industrial money-printing machine with chains attached to cowering piggy bank, bills stamped CONDITIONS
cards.lore: ESSER Funds: $122 Billion available... if you implement SEL and surveillance. The bribe is the trap.
cards.name: COVID RELIEF FUNDS
cards.power: Stimulus Bribe. Gain resources, but accept a permanent "Debt" token.

cards.art: single yellow canary in ornate Victorian cage, door shut, window visible behind
cards.lore: Separation creates dependency. "When reduced to confusion, the individual is ready for re-education."
cards.name: THE LOCKDOWN
cards.power: Isolation. A player cannot interact with others for one round.

cards.art: brown dog with deep sad eyes wearing tight blue surgical mask
cards.lore: De-individualization. Covering the face to remove identity and empathy.
cards.name: THE MASK
cards.power: Silence. Block a "Speech" or "Protest" card.

cards.art: sheep in suit holding QR-coded health certificate, scanning device aimed at it
cards.lore: The precursor to Digital ID. "No jab, no job." The ultimate compliance test.
cards.name: THE VAX PASSPORT
cards.power: Show Your Papers. A player must reveal a "Health" card or leave the game.

cards.art: fanged gremlin enthusiastically chewing through server room cables, sparks flying
cards.lore: Technology is fragile. One little nibble and the grid goes down.
cards.name: THE GLITCH
cards.power: System Failure. Remove all 'Digital' cards from play.

cards.art: overalls-wearing monkey swinging wrench at massive GLOBAL CONTROL industrial machine
cards.lore: Throw a wrench in the gears. Non-compliance is the ultimate weapon.
cards.name: THE SABOTEUR
cards.power: Disrupt. Cancel the effect of a 'Globalist' card.

cards.art: innocent teddy bear looking into ornate mirror, reflection shows snarling dark monster
cards.lore: The Great Reset only works if you believe the lie. Look closer.
cards.name: THE REALITY CHECK
cards.power: Reveal Truth. Expose a "Trojan Horse" card for what it really is.

cards.art: grinning yellow rabbit in rumpled coat holding scissors and anti-mandate posters, chaotic energy
cards.lore: I prefer chaos unmonetised. Stay curious. Stay unruly. Question everything.
cards.name: UNCLE FRIZZLEBOB
cards.power: Cut & Play. Cut this card out to win the moral victory, regardless of the score.
